question: Which physical response terms explain the remaining partitioned-history discrepancy, and do natural decay coordinates remove the predicted leading error?
scope: Stationary representation and symbolic mechanism study on saved fabricated inputs. No optimizer, truth, aging, deployment qualification or long causal trajectory.

baseline.queries: Unchanged saved129 points; local domain retains97.

hypotheses_before_evaluation: At short exposure, the exact free/forced hysteresis responses are 1-gamma_plus*Qplus-gamma_minus*Qminus+O(Q^2) and gamma_plus*Qplus-gamma_minus*Qminus+O(Q^2). A polynomial in log gamma approximates even these first-order terms; a polynomial in physical gamma reproduces them exactly.

At degree4 the physical-gamma total-degree projection reproduces every throughput expansion term through degree4; approximation has O(exposure^5) behavior near zero. Log-gamma projection generally retains an O(exposure) error.

Free RC response is exp(-lambda*t) and forced response is a sum of exponential differences, lambda=1/tau. Direct inverse-time-constant coordinates may improve the physical Laplace-response approximation; no universal improvement is presumed.
A total-degree4 bivariate hysteresis basis omits terms with i+j>4 even though values were sampled on a5x5 grid. Full tensor4 isolates this omitted mixed-coefficient effect at a larger feature count.
Likelihood error equals sum(r*delta)+0.5*sum(delta^2); coherent small response errors can dominate through their correlation with fabricated residuals, independently of numerical roundoff.

diagnostics.attribution: Preserve all cross terms. At each query contribution_j=sum(delta_j*(r+0.5*delta_total)); report signed differences at the SAME maximum/minimum total-gap pair.
diagnostics.substitution_scope: Mechanism controls only; not compressed implementations or data-driven state corrections.
diagnostics.arithmetic: Use long-double accumulation of the residual-gap identity; compare direct squared residuals and inherited C reference. No normal-moment cost evaluation in scientific scores.

weak_exposure.outputs: free/forced hysteresis peak approximation error, normalized order ratios and roundoff qualification; scaled decoded currents are declared analytical controls, not new ADC records.

checks.finite_numerical_mismatches: record and continue, no tolerance changes

reporting.criterion: Report continuous error and physical response discrepancies. Historical0.1NLL shown only as a comparison marker, never a new physical acceptance requirement.
reporting.memory: Report factor/boundary lower bounds and prior complete planning convention. Tensor expansion is a diagnostic, not a proposed SRAM fit.
reporting.limits: Finite query results do not prove task accuracy, support-wide bounds, coverage or deployability. No promise of another particular improvement factor.
